remarks: Welcome to the Lyra by Coventry Homes, a beautiful blend of style, space & comfort designed for the way you live! Featuring a SEPARATE ENTRANCE & 9' ceilings on the main floor & basement, this stunning home is designed to impress. The bright, open-concept main floor brings everyone together, with a beautiful kitchen featuring gorgeous cabinetry, quartz countertops, stainless steel appliances, tile backsplash & a walk-through pantry. The inviting living room & adjoining dining area offer the perfect setting for family time & entertaining. A half bath completes the main floor. Upstairs, escape to your spacious primary retreat with a walk-in closet & luxurious 5pc ensuite featuring dual sinks, a freestanding soaker tub & stand-up shower. Two more bedrooms, a full bath, bonus room & convenient upstairs laundry complete this beautiful home. Backed by the Alberta New Home Warranty Program. *Home is under construction* (id:67522)
